text:
The Avalanche arrive on the second night of a back-to-back, fresh off a 5-2 comeback win in Chicago last night that stretched their winning streak to three. They're missing Josh Manson and Zachary L'Heureux. The Blue Jackets, rested for two days, lost 3-1 in Dallas on Saturday and are 2-3-0 in their last five. The sideshow is Valeri Nichushkin, who faces Colorado for the first time since leaving after 404 games in their colours. Corey Masisak of the Denver Post posted that the Avs will play him tonight.

Our numbers favour COL, 3.39 expected goals to 2.76 (expected goals measure the quality of chances). At five on five the Avalanche have taken 54% of them, Columbus 48%. COL's results run ahead of its chances, though, so finishing is doing plenty of the lifting. In net, projected starters Scott Wedgewood (COL, minus 2.9 goals saved above expected this season) and Cam Talbot (CBJ, plus 2.5) have been on opposite sides of that measure, though Wedgewood was at plus 23.6 last year and Talbot at minus 13.7.

Nathan MacKinnon is 41% to score and 84% for a point, riding a five-game point streak. Artturi Lehkonen has 13 points in his last ten. For Columbus, Kent Johnson has 10 points in ten games. Our under-the-radar picks are Gabriel Landeskog (COL), a third-liner with 2.8 expected goals in his last ten (21% to score, 43% for a point), and Adam Fantilli (CBJ), whose line creates chances (54% for a point). Both are players to watch, not locks.
